name: Shree Ram Proteins Limited
summary: Shree Ram Proteins Limited engages in pressing and crushing of cotton seeds in India. Its products include cotton linter, seed meal, seed hull, seed wash oil, and seed refine oil; and soybean meal, rapeseed meal, groundnut meal, and raw cotton bales. The company also exports its products. Shree Ram Proteins Limited was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Rajkot, India.
